text: Setting choice: Forgotten Realms, a small invented realm in the Border Kingdoms (south of the Lake of Steam), 1491 DR. The Border Kingdoms are a patchwork of tiny realms that rise and fall, so a new kingdom fits canon.
Lines: none requested. The player is 18+ and mature themes are fine; handle them with craft, not gratuitously. The X-card (typing X) still skips anything immediately.
Veil / table preference: the player must not be shown DM-only information (plot goals, NPC intentions, secrets). See the dm-secrecy block.

Table setup: solo player with one PC; grimdark tone; RoboDM rolls all dice; strict RAW with rules_audit=always; house rules: no encumbrance, unlimited ammo after first purchase, no food/water rules; OOC: prefix means out-of-character talk.

PC concept: Chadickith, a 7 ft, 318 lb Dodrud: a homebrew woolly-mammoth variant of the Loxodon (GGR), purely cosmetic with no rules changes. Tortoiseshell coat of lion-tan and bistre-brown fur. Egotistical know-it-all who gets humbled often. Starts at level 3, standard array, all sourcebooks allowed.
Chadickith backstory: as a child his village was wiped out by a blood-raged roc; he was rescued and raised by a fire giant.
House rule: firearms (DMG optional) are for Artificers only.
